metadata.description: Wire format for list-mode `GET /v1/packages` (no `q` query): a paginated package row set assembled from the usable view of the index. Read by raw `curl | jq` consumers (`foreign_parsers = many`). Source of truth for the writer: `crates/vibe-index/src/server/routes/packages.rs` (`ListResponse`, `PackageRow`, `list_or_search`); the generated reader lives in `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/index_http/e1/package_list_response/`.
Always `list` for this response.
The registry name held by the in-memory index.
How many package rows matched before pagination. The writer narrows its in-memory length to u32.
How many rows the packages array carries. The writer uses usize; uint32 is JTD's widest exact unsigned integer and the practical page bound.
The pagination offset applied to the matched rows. The writer uses usize; uint32 is the narrowest useful claim JTD can make.
The requested page size, defaulting to 50. The writer uses usize; uint32 is the narrowest useful claim JTD can make.
The selected page, sorted by `(group, name)`. Required: a matchless or fully offset request writes an empty array, never an absent key.
One package identity with every version this build can act on and any refused versions named beside that usable set.

The package kind read from a usable version, or null when the usable set is empty. The key is always present. Kept as a nullable string because the codegen layer does not yet transform nullable vocabulary refs into open enums.
The package's reverse-FQDN group qualifier.
The package's bare name.
The newest non-prerelease version this build can act on, or null when none exists. The key is always present.
Every version this build can act on, in ascending order. Required: an all-refused package writes an empty array.
The newest usable version's description, or null when it declares none. The key is always present.
Versions this build refuses to act on. Absent when there are none because the writer skips an empty vector.
One package version this build refuses and the recovery recipe, mirroring `crates/vibe-index/src/index/quarantine.rs::Unavailable`.
The refused version's group qualifier.
The refused version's bare package name.
The refused semantic version.
Reader capabilities named by the record but unknown to this build, in record order.
The generated explanation and fix surface for the refusal.
